questions.question: By interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct? 7 and 4
questions.questionHtml:
By interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct?

7 and 4
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Let's check each option one by one:

Given: 7 and 4

Option 1) 4 - 7 + 6 ÷ 2 × 3 = 12

After interchanging the number we get the;

⇒ 7 - 4 + 6 ÷ 2 × 3 = 12

⇒ 7 - 4 + 3 × 3 = 12

⇒ 7 - 4 + 9 = 12

⇒ 16 - 4 = 12

⇒ 12 = 12

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 2) 4 × 3 + 7 - 9 ÷ 3 = 20

After interchanging the number we get the;

⇒ 7 × 3 + 4 - 9 ÷ 3 = 20

⇒ 7 × 3 + 4 - 3 = 20

⇒ 21 + 4 - 3 = 20

⇒ 25 - 3 = 20

⇒ 22 ≠ 20

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) 7 + 4 × 2 - 6 ÷ 2 = 17

After interchanging the number we get the;

⇒ 4 + 7 × 2 - 6 ÷ 2 = 17

⇒ 4 + 7 × 2 - 3 = 17

⇒ 4 + 14 - 3 = 17

⇒ 18 - 3 = 17

⇒ 15 ≠ 17

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) 7 + 5 × 2 - 4 ÷ 1 = 9

After interchanging the number we get the;

⇒ 4 + 5 × 2 - 7 ÷ 1 = 9

⇒ 4 + 5 × 2 - 7 = 9

⇒ 4 + 10 - 7 = 9

⇒ 14 - 7 = 9

⇒ 7 ≠ 9

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: Motion of an object is __________ if its velocity is constant.
questions.questionHtml: Motion of an object is __________ if its velocity is constant.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is uniform.

Key Points

  • It is known as uniform motion when an object moves in a straight path as direction remains constant at a constant speed.
  • This indicates that the body's velocity stays constant as it travels the same distance in the same amount of time.

Additional Information 

Non-Uniform Motion:

  • When an object travels at varying speeds and does not cover the same distance in a constant amount of time.

Speed:

  • Speed is a change in an object's location in any direction.
  • Speed is also defined as the ratio of distance to the amount of time it took to cover that distance. 

Direction:

  • Direction is characterized as the course that anything follows. 
  • The route that must be taken to go to a particular location. 
  • The direction in which something is beginning to take shape, or the direction you are facing.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The trainee wanted to know the______of the course to get a better understanding of the job prospects.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The trainee wanted to know the______of the course to get a better understanding of the job prospects.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1), i.e., 'ins and outs.'

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meaning of the idioms/phrases given in the options:
    Idioms Meaning
    ins and outs the detailed or complicated facts of something. (किसी चीज का विस्तृत या जटिल तथ्य)
    bird's eye view a broad view of a situation. (एक स्थिति का व्यापक दृष्टिकोण)
    crying need a very obvious need. (एक बहुत स्पष्ट आवश्यकता)
    tall talk boasting or exaggerated storytelling. (शेखी बघारना या अतिरंजित कहानी कहना)
  • The context of the sentence is that to better understand the job prospects, the trainee wanted to understand all the details of the course.
  • According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate phrase to fill in the blank is "ins and outs."
  • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.
  • Another example:

questions.question: The question below consists of a set of labeled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph. P. questions.questionHtml:
The question below consists of a set of labeled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

P. They are on the market already but they are costly.

Q. Their cost depends on the sort you install and the size of your home.

R. These devices extract warmth from the air or the ground, or from water - a bit like a fridge operating in reverse.

S. Climate advisers anticipate that most homes in future will be warmed by heat pumps.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. "SRPQ." 
Key Points

  • In the above-mentioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
  • Sentence S is the first sentence as it begins with the noun 'Climate advisers' and mentions climate experts predict that in the future, heat pumps will be used to heat the majority of homes.
  • Sentence R is the second sentence as it begins with the pronoun 'These devices' in place of 'heat pumps' and mentions like a refrigerator running backwards, heat pumps draw warmth from the air, the ground, or water. Thus, it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
  • Sentence P is the third sentence as it begins with the pronoun 'They' in place of 'heat pumps' and further elaborates that heat pumps are already available in market, but they are expensive.
  • The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 3.
  • Sentence Q is the last sentence as it begins with the pronoun 'their cost' and mentions that the type and size of your home determine the price of heat pumps. Thus establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
  • Thus, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

The correct order is: 

S. Climate advisers anticipate that most homes in future will be warmed by heat pumps.

R. These devices extract warmth from the air or the ground, or from water - a bit like a fridge operating in reverse.

P. They are on the market already but they are costly.

Q. Their cost depends on the sort you install and the size of your home.
